title: Clip Squad
premise: Four kids run a rising video channel and fight to stay ahead of a rival creator. The data is views, polls, watch time and a suspicious average.

companion.name: BLINK
companion.about: a camera drone with opinions; buzzes in, judges everyone's footage

cast.DEX: stunt kid; reckless, every stunt ends in a replay
cast.JAYLEN: hype man; loud, loves the comments section
cast.MAX MAXWELL: rival creator; flashy, bends the numbers

gag: Every one of Dex's stunts ends in a replay.

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, hot coral, electric teal and sunny yellow palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.nova: a girl age 11 with light brown skin, curly dark hair in a high puff, a red beanie and a black hoodie, holding a small handheld camera
fragments.dex: a boy age 11 with light skin, spiky blond hair, a sky blue t-shirt, knee pads and a skateboard helmet
fragments.mei: a girl age 11 with light skin, straight black hair with bangs, round headphones around her neck and a yellow cardigan, holding a laptop
fragments.jaylen: a boy age 11 with dark brown skin, short twists, a bright green jersey and a backward cap, grinning
fragments.blink: a small round white camera drone with four little propellers and one big glowing camera lens eye
fragments.max: a boy age 12 with tan skin, swoopy dyed silver hair, sunglasses on his head and a shiny gold jacket, smug grin
fragments.studio: a kid's video studio in a garage with ring lights, a green screen, blank monitors and posters with blank faces
